steps.heading: The publish ladder
steps.text: Every claim climbs candidate → reviewed → signed → anchored → published, one deliberate rung at a time. The counts here are the whole workbench at a glance — unpublished is a good terminal state, not a backlog to burn down.

steps.heading: The claim forest
steps.text: Compound claims nest the atoms they're built from; evidence hangs off as leaves. Click a claim to review it in the middle pane, a paper to read it on the right — the same tree /claim/<id> opens into on its own.

steps.heading: Review, then sign
steps.text: A claim's state, its evidence DAG, and one action box that offers exactly what its current state allows. Approve freezes the sentence and its grounding; sign is a human-only door — no worker, no agent can reach it — that certifies a person looked.

steps.heading: The evidence, in place
steps.text: Click an evidence paper and its reader loads right here, so you can check a quote against its source without losing your place in the forest.
